python -c "
import humanize
import inspect

# Check all public functions have type hints
public_funcs = [
    'Unit', 'activate', 'apnumber', 'clamp', 'deactivate', 
    'fractional', 'get_translation', 'intcomma', 'intword',
    'naturaldate', 'naturalday', 'naturaldelta', 'naturalsize',
    'naturaltime', 'ordinal', 'precisedelta', 'scientific', 'metric'
]

for name in public_funcs:
    func = getattr(humanize, name, None)
    if func is not None:
        sig = inspect.signature(func)
        print(f'{name}: {sig}')
    else:
        print(f'{name}: NOT FOUND')
"
